name: Noble Matter SEO Radar
author: noblematter

sections.description:
SEO Radar measures how findable your business is in Google and in AI answers. This plugin brings that audit into WordPress, where you fix things.

  • Dashboard widget with your radar score, your site audit score and the improvements to do first.
  • Site audit per page: every issue, grouped per page, with a link to edit that page.
  • Fix with one click where it is safe: missing alt texts, meta descriptions and SEO titles. Every proposal comes from your own content (title, excerpt, first lines), you can change it, and you see a preview before anything is saved.
  • Works with your SEO plugin: titles and descriptions are saved where Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO read them. Without an SEO plugin, SEO Radar adds the meta description and title itself.
  • Alt texts are saved in the media library, so every theme and page builder uses them.

The plugin works from the Essentials plan of SEO Radar. The plugin is translation ready; translations are delivered through translate.wordpress.org.

External service

This plugin connects to SEO Radar (https://seoradar.be), run by Noble Matter, a trade name of SOCIALWORLD CommV (Antwerp, Belgium). It only does so after you paste your key, and only from your server, never from the browser of your visitors.

  • What is sent: your key, and the address of your site in the User-Agent. No content of your site and no data of your visitors.
  • When: when you open the dashboard or an SEO Radar screen (answers are kept for 10 minutes), and when you connect.
  • Terms: https://seoradar.be/voorwaarden
  • Privacy: https://seoradar.be/privacy

The proposals for alt texts, descriptions and titles are made inside WordPress. They are not sent anywhere.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. In SEO Radar, open Koppelingen and make a key.
  3. In WordPress, go to SEO Radar > Settings, paste the key and click Connect.
sections.faq:
Does it change anything on its own?

No. Nothing is saved before you tick it, check the preview and click Apply.

I use Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO.

Good. The plugin writes into their fields. You see the result in their box under each page as usual.

What happens when I remove the plugin?

The key and the cached answers are removed. Your fixes stay, they are your content now.
